name: Too Many Weapons
desc:
⚔️ Add weapons and powerups as you battle hordes of enemies to ascend the tower 🗼

🥚 Play as an angry egg. Build your weapon arsenal to defeat increasing waves of enemies 💥
🔫🗡️ Unlock over 50 unique weapons to use, including swords, guns and turrets 🏹🔪
💰 A Roguelike style upgrade system to make each run strategic and unique! 🔨
🏆🗼 Do you have what it takes to reach the top? 🗼🏆

Inspired by roguelike games such as Brotato, Vampire Survivors and Risk of Rain!

Private servers are FREE!
